findings.comment: Site plan does not show setback dimensions from property lines to building faces. MF-2 zoning setback compliance must be verified and dimensioned on the site plan, showing distance from property boundary to the nearest building face for all sides of the development.

applicableAreas: parkland deficient area polygon on site
findings.comment: Parkland boundaries are not shown on the site plan. Facts documentation confirms that the property is within a Parkland Deficient Area (2 polygon features intersect the parcel), requiring parkland dedication or fee-in-lieu per § 25-1-604(B). Parkland boundary areas must be delineated on the site plan.

Site is 2.16 acres (exceeds the 1-acre trigger under § 25-1-85). No compliance documentation has been provided for the closed municipal solid waste landfill buffer requirement. One of the following three methods must be submitted: (a) PE certification that the site does not overlie a closed landfill with basis for determination; (b) TCEQ development permit; or (c) PE certification that soil testing will be conducted per TCEQ requirements during foundation construction.
